method: C2W: exact frozen C2Q checkpoint transfer, no optimization; 120Hz continuous physical success clock; anchored SDK station-keeping; stationary vertical phase estimate; raw policy inputs and original physical gates unchanged

controller.translation: current position relative on commanded axes; previous target on orthogonal axes
controller.protective_stop: capture current position when interrupting translation

task_spec.trainable: all C2Q readouts and MaleCNS frozen; opt-in anchored SDK and consistent stationary vertical estimate
task_spec.phase_manager: measured pose/velocity only, completed SDK option; no movement direction selection
task_spec.neural_handoff: reset neural lane, preserve physical integration state, target, clock; one new10Hz observation

phase_estimator.fields: only vertical position averaged when20samples span<=.02m and measured vertical speeds<=.08m/s; otherwise current raw height; horizontal position and all speeds always raw; invalid data clears history
phase_estimator.final_success: unchanged true physical state and original tolerances

task_spec.success_clock: 120Hz continuous physical tick validation;10Hz observations and4neural substeps unchanged

disturbance.force_frame: world XYZ; horizontal .006N plus alternating vertical +/-.006N; yaw torque .00003Nm
disturbance.noise: Gaussian position sigma .002m, yaw sigma .0004rad in pose/combined
disturbance.scope: synthetic engineering disturbances, not aircraft-calibrated wind

training_seed_formula: no new training; formally trained frozen C2Q seeds11/22/33 transferred without parameter changes
rehearsal: none; no optimization or data fitting
labels: real10Hz states at5Hz; navigation/heading STOP x2; altitude settled-only, abs(error).06-.14m symmetric x4
selection: all3 final C2Q weights fixed before this software repair and all new cases; no seed/checkpoint selection or heldout tuning
